manifesto.title: A brand shouldn’t interrupt.
manifesto.body: PEpL is an embeddable system that integrates into personal-change platforms — gyms, habit apps, progress communities. Brands appear at the user's emotional peak, when a real achievement is validated. Not before. Not after.

features.card1Body: Simple technical integration. PEpL plugs into your app, CRM or attendance system — without replacing anything you already have.
features.card2Body: You only pay when a real, verified achievement occurs. Every activated reward is auditable, measurable and reportable.
features.card3Body: Your brand appears at the user's emotional peak. It doesn't interrupt — it celebrates. That's when conversion is highest.
features.testimonialQuote: Our partners record up to 3× higher conversion rates compared to any traditional channel.

problema.title: Traditional advertising no longer works.
problema.card1Body: Traditional formats are ignored. Brands pay for impressions nobody sees or remembers. Average CTR has dropped below 0.1%.
problema.card2Body: Brands chase authenticity while users reject generic advertising that doesn't speak to their values.
problema.card3Body: Ads interrupt the experience. The result: rejection, ad-blockers and irreversible loss of brand trust.
